# Release v0.19.1 state fixture

`state.db` was created with the `v0.19.1` tag's `go/engine/store/dbfile`, `state`, and `auth` packages. It is at schema version 19. `master.key` was generated by that release's `OpenMasterKey` method. Both files contain synthetic test data only.

The database holds an administrator, an account with a sealed TOTP secret, a sealed configuration value, and an upload session with one completed interval. The fixture has no user data or deployed credentials. The test copies both files before opening them, so migrations leave this release snapshot unchanged.
